name: @cjdevstudios/bumblevue
author: CJ Development Studios
description: BumbleVue is an open source UI library for Vue featuring a rich set of 80+ components, a theme designer, various theme alternatives such as Material, Bootstrap, Tailwind, premium templates and professional support. In addition, it integrates with PrimeBlock, which has 370+ ready to use UI blocks to build spectacular applications in no time.

scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production INPUT_DIR=src/ OUTPUT_DIR=dist/ pnpm run build:package
scripts.build:package: pnpm run build:prebuild && pnpm run build:api && rollup -c && pnpm run build:postbuild
